dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Bulletin Board is set up by the Mahamata to publicize important matters in Sumeru City. Questions or doubts regarding the notices on the Bulletin Board can be posted here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Have you heard? The Forest Watchers found a magnificent palace that came into being from nowhere in the north of the forest."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But everyone who went there got cheated out of all the money they had. All they had left is their underwear when the Forest Watchers found them."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And they were crying and refused to say what happened. It's absolutely horrifying."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's best not to wander around in the forest."

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: The announcements throughout Sumeru are being displayed via the Akasha now. Please wear your Akasha Terminal at all times to avoid missing any important notices.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: This Bulletin Board will be temporarily kept for the convenience of foreign merchants, the elderly, and children. It may be removed anytime in the future. Please refrain from relying on it too much.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Distribution of this year's Anahitian Blessing has begun.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: In principle, distribution will be carried out according to last year's policies and requirements. Details of relevant information have been posted in the Akasha.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: If there are any changes, please contact your nearest Mahamata in advance to submit a modification request to the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Cases of Eleazar have been on the rise in the city. If you experience symptoms including numbness of the skin, weakness in the limbs, or gray and black scales forming on the torso, please go to Bimarstan to receive treatment immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Missing the best window for treatment and allowing the condition to take a turn for the worse will lead to severe consequences, such as incapacitation. Please take heed of this notice.

dialogues.speaker: Corps of Thirty Announcement
dialogues.text: Special reminder: The Eremites are the only authorized mercenary organization in Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Corps of Thirty Announcement
dialogues.text: Please do not trust strangers easily in case of getting cheated by scammers.

dialogues.speaker: Corps of Thirty Announcement
dialogues.text: If you wish to hire bodyguards, security staff, or have any other requests, please contact Parchamdar Rukh Shah from the Corps of Thirty or post a commission via the Akademiya's liaison, Effendi.

dialogues.speaker: Bimarstan Notice
dialogues.text: Bimarstan is a medical facility under Amurta that provides free medical care to all residents of Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Bimarstan Notice
dialogues.text: Bimarstan's doctors are licensed by Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta. Our diagnoses and treatment plans are reviewed multiple times by the Akasha. We provide the safest, most professional medical services for all Sumeru residents.

dialogues.speaker: Bimarstan Notice
dialogues.text: Please do not trust unidentified or unlicensed doctors to avoid financial losses and irreversible harm to your health.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Please do not carry too much Mora in crowded areas as a precaution against theft.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: If you find your properties stolen, please do not seek help from the Eremites patrolling in the vicinity.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Because it's very likely that they are the culprit.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty Notice: Kasim

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: This man claims to be a renowned bandit who travels across nations, but he is in fact a fraud who has never appeared in the power rankings of the Eremites.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Many fraud cases linked to him have been reported lately. Please stay vigilant and avoid falling for his scams.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: Bounty Notice: Mustah

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: This man disguises himself as a Mahamata to engage in extortion and robbery around the port of the Bazaar. The Citadel of Regzar is now conducting investigations on him.

dialogues.speaker: Arrest Warrant
dialogues.text: There are reports of him hiding in the jungle. Please report any sightings of him.

dialogues.speaker: Lambad's Tavern Notice
dialogues.text: Since the Mahamata won't be using this to post announcements anymore, it's perfect as a message board for our tavern. Please feel free to leave a message here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Have the ten crates of wine that I ordered arrived? I came yesterday only to find out they didn't arrive."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "That's impossible! A blond person came in here earlier claiming to be your roommate and took it all. I even remember both of you coming in together the other day. You must have made a mistake."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...Alright. I get it."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Be careful if you're planning a trip to the rainforest. My mentor sent me there to collect some herbs the other day, and I almost lost my life to a Rishboland Tiger."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I was lucky to be saved by a Forest Ranger nearby. She called herself a Trainee Forest Ranger, but she seemed really experienced. Most importantly, she gave me delicious food to help ease my shock."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've heard that she's Tighnari's student. It's just as they say — like teacher, like pupil!"

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Travelers from afar, welcome to Sumeru. As a display of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's kindness and mercy for all, Akasha Terminals are now available to all tourists.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Tourists can claim one from Mahamata Panah upon arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Travelers from afar, welcome to Sumeru. As a display of the Dendro Archon's kindness and mercy for all, Akasha Terminals are now available to all tourists.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Tourists can claim one from Mahamata Panah upon arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Travelers from afar, welcome to Sumeru. Since the Akasha system is no longer in use, the Akasha Terminals are no longer available.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: If you still have an Akasha Terminal that has not yet been recalled, please return it to the Mahamata Panah before leaving Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: As the Akasha System is no longer in use, the bulletin board has now been recommissioned for the convenience of local residents and travelers.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: All important matters throughout Sumeru will be posted here on a regular basis. Should any crucial information be missing, please contact related personnel from the Akademiya.
